title: Locked memory admission, inspection and history

claims.text: put validates the unit shape, compares the command args against the memory payload, and admits through journal.transact with a memory.put draft and a render returning the unit, memory_gen and commit proof.

_validate_put enforces ownership and scope, ruling quote digest equality, run attribution and open-run ownership, inherited source digest and eligibility, reciprocal replacement graph acyclicity, and the 6000-byte/4000-token entry capacity through _capacity.

operator_ruling requires operator actor and authority, derives the ruling id and quote receipt from the quote sha256, publishes the quote immutably via _publish_quote, and replaces the caller op_id with the deterministic ruling identity.

decision.rule: Change here when memory admission, ownership, replacement graph, entry capacity, or operator ruling publication needs to change.
decision.failure: A valid unit is rejected, a ruling is retired by a non-operator, or an inadmissible unit commits without headroom.

questions.q: Where does _validate_put check the replacement graph and entry capacity for a memory write?
Where should I change how operator_ruling derives its operation identity from the quote?
Where can I debug why a memory put fails with memory_debt after a prior write?
